source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: topic 3.2 with the Do You Know box (PDF 37-38, printed 33-34).

blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) ke kai bunyadi concepts hain jo programs ko munazzam (organized), dobara istemal ke qabil (reusable) aur sambhalne mein aasan banate hain. Yeh concepts hain: classes aur objects, encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Class aik blueprint (naqsha) ki tarah hai, aur object woh asal cheez hai jo us naqshe se banti hai.
